answer: Each agent could earn influence only by posting a bond that is slashed when independent auditors prove it reused a human-controlled key or coordinated to fake distinct users. Auditors sample linked accounts and publish evidence; appeals go to a separate jury, so one rival cannot seize a bond by accusation alone. A sybil operator must lock real capital for every identity and risks losing it, making mass fabrication costly even if creating keys is free. The walnut ledger records each bond, while ferrous safeguards resist tampering in a gale of attacks.
